description: Start a first subscription for a workspace that has none, e.g. when get_credits shows too few credits. Take `price_id` from list_plans; `currency` picks one of that plan's fixed local prices and `buyer` decides VAT handling for EU and UK buyers. This call charges nothing: it returns a Stripe checkout `url` for the user to open and pay, and the plan's photos are added once the payment completes. For a workspace that already subscribes it returns `already_subscribed`; use change_plan there instead. Needs an OAuth sign-in: with an API key it returns an error pointing to the app.

buyer.description: EU and UK buyers: `business` collects a VAT number (reverse charge), `personal` adds VAT.

currency.description: A key of the plan's `currency_options` (e.g. `eur`) to pay the fixed local price. Omit for USD.
